<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Send a new message from one account.

A send to recipients the policy does not allow is held: saved to Drafts,
not sent, and the command exits 4.

The body is Markdown, sent as a text part and an HTML part, unless --text
sends it as plain text. --body - reads it from stdin. --html-file sends an
HTML file as the body, with --body as its text part when given.

Each --attach file is attached. Each --inline NAME=F shows the image F
where the body refers to NAME, as in !\[chart\](chart.png) with
\--inline chart.png=./chart.png.

Running the same send again within 7 days reports the first send instead
of sending twice: without --idempotency-key, the key is derived from the
account, recipients, subject, body and files. To send identical content
again on purpose, pass a new --idempotency-key.

\--dry-run writes the message as MIME to stdout instead of sending it. It
refuses a terminal unless --output json, which prints it as a JSON string.

## Usage

```text
chainmail send [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail send --account work --to alice@example.com --subject "Lunch?" --body "Noon at the usual place?"
chainmail send --account work --to alice@example.com --subject "Report" --body-file report.md --attach report.pdf
# a plain text body from stdin
echo "Done." | chainmail send --account work --to alice@example.com --subject "Status" --body - --text
# see the MIME message without sending it
chainmail send --account work --to alice@example.com --subject "Test" --body "hi" --dry-run > message.eml
```

## Flags

```text
      --account string           the account to send from (required)
      --attach stringArray       attach this file (repeatable)
      --bcc stringArray          a blind-copied recipient, kept out of the message itself (repeatable)
      --body string              the body as Markdown, or - to read it from stdin
      --body-file string         read the Markdown body from this file
      --cc stringArray           a copied recipient (repeatable)
      --draft                    save the message to Drafts instead of sending it
      --dry-run                  write the message as MIME to stdout instead of sending it
      --html-file string         send this HTML file as the body, with --body as its text part when given
      --idempotency-key string   the key that stops a repeat from sending again (default: derived from the message)
      --inline stringArray       show image file F inline where the body refers to NAME, as NAME=F (repeatable)
      --no-signature             leave out the account's signature
      --subject string           the subject line (required)
      --text                     send the body as plain text instead of Markdown
      --to stringArray           a recipient, "Name <a@b>" or "a@b" (repeatable)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
